results.original_name: クレバテス-魔獣の王と赤子と屍の勇者
results.overview: One of the Lords of Dark Beasts, Clevatess’s reign shatters when he revives a hero he personally slayed and adopts an orphaned humanoid baby—the last hope to save a dying world. Now bound together, what fate awaits this unlikely trio?
results.name: Clevatess
